title: Supplier Quality Engineer ( WW-209-1)
description:
**Essential Functions**
 Works with suppliers and other sourcing team members with oversight from senior SQE members
   

  

 Executes quality portion of MRB / non\-conformance product issues using established systems
   

  

 Execute basic Quality tools that apply to the product and suppliers assigned. Quality Engineering tools such as: contract review, sampling plans, auditing principals, SPC, MSA, First Articles, FMEA, PFMEA, calibration systems, etc to understand and ultimately resolve issues in the supply base
   

  

 Apply basic understanding of the relevant product or customer specifications, flow down documents, procedures, engineering or process drawings and regulating agent body requirements that apply to the products and suppliers assigned
   

  

 Issues, monitors and maintains corrective action database
   

  

 Works effectively with suppliers to resolve problems using Root Cause Corrective Actions (RCCA) tools
   

  

 Utilizes available data to establish schedules and perform required audits of assigned suppliers
   

  

 Maintains accurate and current supplier quality records, such as supplier audits, certifications, corrective action responses, and database screens
   

  

 Participate with the Sourcing team to select and manage assigned suppliers
   

  

 Executes established Quality plan for assigned suppliers, based upon: Type and complexity of product being procured; quality history of supplier; requirements placed upon items; level of supplier s demonstrated process control; participates in continuous improvement activities
   

  

 Travel to assigned suppliers, as necessary (domestic and international)
   

  

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities**
 Excellent communication skills
   

  

 Team player
   

  

 Self\-starting, but supervision required
   

  

 Detail oriented
   

  

 Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
   

  

 Developing facilitation skills
   

  

 Ability to understand principals of AS9100, ISO\-9000/2000, QS\-9000 and/or TS\-16949
   

  

 Ability to understand principals of Continuous Improvement Methodologies (6 Sigma, Lean Mfg. etc.)
   

  

**Education or Formal Training**
 Bachelor of Engineering
   

  

 4 year degree in technical field
   

  

**Experience**
 5\-7 years of experience in quality, manufacturing, or process control in lieu of degree
   

  

 Previous experience in manufacturing processes and quality systems.
   

  

**Travel Requirements**
 Domestic and international, as required

title: Workday Functional Consultant (Mid-Senior Level)
description:
**ERM** 
 is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organisations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
   

  

 The
 **Global Delivery Centre** 
 (GDC) in Gurugram is ERM’s global operating backbone. It delivers business enablement services in Finance, HR, IT, and Commercial Operations to ensure ERM’s global business runs seamlessly, efficiently, and consistently.
   

  

 At the GDC, you will:
   

  

* Be part of a hub that ensures ERM’s business continuity worldwide.
* Collaborate with colleagues across geographies to support global operations.
* Drive consistency, compliance, and efficiency in core functions.
* Work with digital, automation, and AI\-enabled tools to optimise how ERM operates.
* Work in shifts where required, depending on the role. As processes mature and automation increases, reliance on shifts will reduce.


- 

**Why this role matters?**
 As a
 **Workday Functional Consultant** 
 , you will play a pivotal role in delivering our Workday roadmap by configuring, optimising, and supporting HCM modules across the organisation. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, technical teams, and third\-party vendors to ensure robust, scalable, and efficient HR processes. This role requires strong functional expertise, hands\-on configuration skills, and a passion for continuous improvement in a dynamic, global environment. Experience supporting complex benefits administration, annual Open Enrollment activities, and global employee\-facing HR processes is highly valued.
   

  

**What you’ll bring:**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Workday functional experience, with expertise in at least two modules, including Benefits, Compensation, or Advanced Compensation.
* Proven experience in configuration, process mapping, testing, and continuous improvement of HR processes.
* Experience supporting Benefits administration, configuration, or employee enrolment processes within Workday.
* Workday Pro Certification in Platform Administration and Core HCM.
* Strong understanding of HR processes, compliance requirements, and data governance principles.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and experience working in global delivery models.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills; ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in global deployments and stakeholder management.
* Experience with Benefits integrations involving carriers, payroll providers, or third\-party vendors.
* Workday Pro Certifications in advanced Workday modules (e.g., Benefits, Compensation, Advanced Compensation).


**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and support end\-to\-end configuration and administration of Workday modules: Core HCM, Absence, Talent Acquisition, Performance \& Talent Management, Compensation (Core \& Advanced), Benefits, Journeys, Knowledge, and Case Management.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, design solutions, and deliver high\-quality configurations and enhancements.
* Support Benefits administration activities, including plan configuration, life events, eligibility rules, enrolment processes, integrations, regulatory compliance requirements, and annual Open Enrollment events.
* Ensure compliance with IT governance, audit, and data integrity standards, and support internal/external audits as required.
* Monitor and resolve complex Workday\-related incidents and service requests within SLA, providing clear and timely communication to stakeholders.
* Support Workday releases, regression testing, and change management initiatives, ensuring smooth adoption of new features.
* Prepare and maintain functional documentation, SOPs, and provide knowledge transfer to HR superusers and team members.
* Stay current with Workday functionality, industry trends, and best practices; proactively recommend improvements and process optimisations.


**Working Model**
* The role follows a hybrid working arrangement, designed to facilitate effective global collaboration. Team members are expected to work between 14:00 and 23:00 IST. There may also be occasions when extended working hours are necessary to accommodate cross\-time\-zone activities.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 The team works closely with Quant, Technology and Risk teams to deliver regulatory programs such as FRTB, Full Reval VaR and other risk reporting initiatives.
   

  

 The team’s main responsibility is to design, deliver and maintain data testing frameworks to provide independent assurance over the appropriateness and quality of risk calculations produced by Front Office Technology teams.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role offers exposure to all asset classes (Rates, Commodity, Credit, FX and Equity) and requires strong programming abilities, especially in Python, to develop solutions on the Bank’s strategic platform, Quartz.
   

  

* Engaging with program stakeholders to ensure scope and requirements are well defined
* Understand change requirements and set up tests to examine quality of valuations and scenarios generated by risk technology
* Produce DQ status updates for senior management and provide actionable inputs to Quants and technology for improvement of data quality


**Responsibilities\***
* Understand calculation requirements and implement robust testing frameworks to assess the completeness and reasonableness of base PVs, risk sensitivities, scenarios, VaR and expected shortfall calculations. This includes designing and implementing tests, consolidating results, and analysing calculations to understand key drivers
* Execute scheduled and ad hoc tests on large datasets including PVs and risk calculations
* Raise and investigate data issues and model anomalies
* Collaborate with the Quantitative, Technology and Risk teams on issue resolution and improvement of risk calculation inputs (including market data and models)
* Enhance data accessibility and traceability through improved documentation and data lineage
* Develop high\-performance codebase to enable scaling and the generation of timely, frequent/daily test results


**Requirements\***
**Education** 
 :\- Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative subject (Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Sc, etc.) Postgraduate/Masters in Finance, Mathematics or any other quantitative area
   

  

**Experience Range\*** 
 3 – 5 Years
   

  

**Foundational Skills**
* Strong communication skills
* Team player, self\-starter
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills, experience performing data analyses


**Desired Skills**
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, rapidly assimilate new concepts, and adapt to evolving business priorities and timelines
* Optional: Risk/Capital Markets knowledge is desirable but not strictly necessary, provided there is a willingness to learn
* Ability to identify and escalate risks, suggesting solutions and implement process improvements
* Experience in software development, data engineering and/or automation within financial markets


**Work Timings\* \-** 
 12:30 PM – 9:30 PM
   

  

**Job Location\*** 
 Gurugram

title: Support Quality & Training Specialist
description:
**About the Company:**




 Driffle is a global digital goods marketplace specializing in digital gaming products, including games, gift cards, DLCs and more across 140\+ countries. We are a team of gamers with the aim of making gaming accessible and affordable to everyone. Operating across multiple jurisdictions, Driffle facilitates high\-volume cross\-border transactions and works with global payment service providers to deliver seamless digital commerce experiences.
 



  





**About the Role:**




 The Support Quality \& Training Specialist is responsible for improving support team performance through quality assurance, process training, coaching, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role ensures that customer support interactions meet company standards while supporting the development of team knowledge, service quality, and operational efficiency. The position works closely with Support Operations, Team Leaders, and cross\-functional departments to identify performance gaps, deliver effective training, and enhance support processes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**





 Quality Assurance
 



* Monitor and evaluate customer support interactions on tickets.
* Conduct regular quality audits based on established service standards and KPIs.
* Provide constructive feedback and coaching to support team members.
* Identify recurring quality issues and recommend corrective actions.
* Track and report quality performance trends and improvement opportunities.



  






 Training \& Development
 



* Design, coordinate, and deliver onboarding and refresher training programs.
* Develop training materials, SOPs, process guides, and knowledge base content.
* Conduct workshops and coaching sessions to improve product knowledge, communication, and customer service skills.
* Support continuous learning initiatives for the support team.
* Assess training effectiveness through evaluations and performance monitoring.



  






 Process Improvement
 



* Identify process gaps and inefficiencies within support operations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to improve workflows, customer experience, and operational performance.
* Maintain and update support procedures and quality standards.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and customer service guidelines.



  






 Reporting \& Analysis
 



* Prepare quality and training performance reports for management.
* Analyze support metrics, customer feedback, and QA scores.
* Recommend actionable improvements based on data insights.
* Support performance calibration sessions with team leaders and managers.



  





**Key Requirements:**



* Experience \& Education: Bachelor’s degree preferred with 2\-3 years of experience.
* QA \& Training Expertise: Strong understanding of customer service standards, QA methodologies, and experience creating training materials and conducting coaching sessions.
* Analytical \& Technical Skills: Strong problem\-solving abilities, high attention to detail, and proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM/support systems.
* Execution \& Compliance: Process\-oriented mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities, work cross\-functionally, and drive core KPIs (including QA scores, CSAT, SOP compliance, and error reduction).



  





 Take the next step in your career.
 



 Apply now and submit your application!

title: Solution Services Domain Architect

 Must have:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.

 Good to have:

title: Senior Quality Analyst
description:
**About SaveIN** 
 : SaveIN is a Y\-Combinator\-backed fintech company on a mission to make financial products accessible and affordable for every Indian. We offer Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) and no\-cost EMI solutions through a growing network of Banks, NBFCs, and lending partners, enabling consumers to fund healthcare, education, and everyday needs without financial stress.
 



  





**About the Role** 
 : SaveIN is looking for a Senior QA Engineer with a strong automation focus to help us scale test coverage across our lending and payments platform. You'll work closely with engineering, product, and compliance teams to ensure the reliability, security, and correctness of systems that handle real money movement and sensitive customer data.
 



  





**Employment Type** 
 : Full\-Time
 



**Working Days:** 
 5 days a week
 



**Mode of Work:** 
 On\-Site
 



**Experience Required:** 
 3\-5 years
 



**Reporting To** 
 : CTO
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Design, build, and maintain automated test suites (API, UI, and regression) integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Own the test strategy for critical customer journeys, including onboarding, credit decisioning, disbursement, and repayment/collections.
* Build and maintain automation frameworks for testing integrations with bank partners (HDFC, ICICI, IDFC First) and bureau/KYC providers.
* Identify gaps in test coverage and proactively build automated regression suites to reduce manual QA dependency.
* Collaborate with developers to "shift testing left" by embedding test gates into CI/CD alongside SAST/security checks.
* Perform API contract testing, load/performance testing, and data validation for financial transactions.
* Write clear, reproducible bug reports and work with engineering to drive root\-cause fixes.
* Contribute to the test data management strategy, especially around PII/DPDP\-compliant sandbox data.
* Mentor junior QA engineers and help formalize QA processes, test documentation, and release sign\-off criteria.
* Participate in production incident reviews to identify testing gaps that could have caught issues earlier.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in QA/SDET roles with a strong hands\-on automation focus.
* Proficiency with automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, RestAssured, Karate).
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and integrating automated tests.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data validation and backend testing.
* Experience testing REST APIs, webhooks, and third\-party integrations.
* Basic scripting ability (Java/Python/JavaScript) for writing and maintaining test scripts.
* Understanding of the software testing lifecycle, including test planning, traceability, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Prior experience in fintech, banking, or lending products is a strong plus (understanding of KYC, credit underwriting, or payment flows).
* Familiarity with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6\) is a plus.
* Exposure to security testing basics (e.g., OWASP Top 10\) is a plus, given the regulated environment.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience testing systems with multiple bank/NBFC integrations.
* Familiarity with compliance\-driven QA (e.g., audit trails, RBI/data protection considerations).
* Interest in AI\-assisted testing tools/agentic QA workflows, as this is a growing focus area for our team.

title: Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day\-to\-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge \& ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)

title: CQV Engineer
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 The CQV Engineer will be responsible for the commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment, systems, and processes used in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area. This role ensures that all systems operate as intended and comply with regulatory standards. The CQV Engineer will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Familiarity with risk\-based approaches to C\&Q (e.g., ASTM E2500, ISPE).
* Develop and execute commissioning and qualification lifecycle protocols for new and existing process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities.
* Prepare C\&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and as per regulatory requirements.
* Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP \& SIP systems
* Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies.
* Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design.
* Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C\&Q.
* Review vendor documents (CTOP/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements.
* Ensure non\-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner.
* Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews.
* Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site.
* Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction.
* System Startup activities
* Supervise vendors/ contractors on site during commissioning activities.
* Ensure compliance with current industry regulations and guidelines relating to Commissioning, qualification and validation.
* Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including protocols, reports, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure all CQV activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EMA) and industry standards (e.g., ISPE, ASTM).
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless project execution.
* Provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.


**Working Conditions**
* The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities.
* Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements.
* Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.
* 5\-8 year’s experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing.
* Experience with writing and executing commissioning, qualification, and validation of biopharmaceutical equipment and systems (e.g., bioreactors, chromatography systems, filtration systems)
* Experience in preparing Risk assessments for new and existing process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities.


**Technical Skills**
* Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis.
* Strong understanding of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Experience with process validation and computer system validation.
* Familiar with Delta\-V and other PCS/ DCS systems is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team


 At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
   

  

 Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
   

  

 At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
   

  

 We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
   

  

 Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Client Services and Administration
description:
Company Description
 



 Synergetic Communication Inc. is a debt collection agency focused on combining a customer\-centric approach with advanced technology to achieve effective delinquent account recovery. The company emphasizes innovation, using modern tools and streamlined processes to improve efficiency, transparency, and communication. Its compliance\-driven operations aim to foster trust and satisfaction among both clients and consumers. Team members are expected to balance strong results with respectful, empathetic interactions. Synergetic Communication Inc. is committed to redefining industry standards by aligning technology, communication, and positive consumer experiences.
 



  





 Role Description
 



 We are expanding our Client Services and Administration team with multiple full\-time, on\-site openings based in Gurugram, India. This team is the operational and compliance backbone of the business, supporting consumer interactions, data integrity, training delivery, quality assurance, audit readiness, and platform uptime. Candidates are encouraged to apply once and indicate in their application which function best matches their experience; we will consider applicants across all openings.
 



  





 Open Functions
 



  





 Consumer Disputes \- Research, document, and resolve consumer disputes end to end. Review account histories, gather supporting documentation, prepare written responses within regulatory timeframes, and escalate issues that require compliance or legal review.
 



  





 Data Entry \- Accurately enter, validate, and maintain account and consumer records across internal platforms. Reconcile incoming client files, correct data discrepancies, and maintain the record quality that downstream reporting and compliance depend on.
 



  





 Learning Management System Admin (LMS) \- Administer the company learning platform: build and publish courses, manage user accounts and permissions, assign and track required compliance training, troubleshoot learner issues, and report on completion rates and certification status.
 



  





 Quality Call Scoring \- Monitor and score recorded consumer calls against quality and compliance scorecards. Document findings, identify coaching opportunities and trends, and partner with operations leadership to raise consistency across the floor.
 



  





 Internal Audit Testwork \- Execute internal audit test procedures across operational and compliance controls. Pull and review samples, document evidence and exceptions, prepare clear workpapers, and support remediation tracking through to closure.
 



  





 System Monitoring Admin \- Monitor production systems, dialer platforms, and scheduled processes for availability and errors. Track alerts, run daily health checks, log and escalate incidents, and maintain monitoring documentation and shift handoff notes.
 



  





 Qualifications
 


* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to document work clearly and professionally.
* Solid computer proficiency, including Microsoft Excel and Word, and comfort learning new business platforms quickly.
* High attention to detail and accuracy when working with records, documentation, and consumer data.
* Ability to follow defined procedures, meet deadlines, and work within a regulated, compliance\-focused environment.
* Sound judgment in handling confidential and sensitive consumer information.
* Ability to work on\-site in Gurugram, India, on assigned shifts, and to collaborate with operations, compliance, and management teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in BPO, collections, financial services, customer service, quality assurance, audit, or systems administration is an advantage.
* Function\-specific experience is preferred but not required: dispute handling or complaints for Consumer Disputes; high\-volume data processing for Data Entry; LMS or training coordination for LMS Admin; QA scorecards or call monitoring for Quality Call Scoring; audit or controls testing for Internal Audit Testwork; monitoring tools, ticketing, or basic SQL for System Monitoring Admin.



 Please indicate your preferred function or functions in your application.

title: Quality Control Engineer (Mechanical)
company: SVS Life Safety (a div of SVS Buildwel P Ltd)
description:
**Job title:** 
 QC Engineer — Fire Suppression Manufacturing \& Gas Cylinder Filling
 



**Company:** 
 SVS Buildwel Private Limited
 



**Location:** 
 Neetaji Subhash vihar Indl Area, Tikri, Delhi · On\-site
 



**Employment type:** 
 Full\-time · Mid\-Senior level
 



**Job function:** 
 Quality Assurance · Manufacturing
 



**Industry:** 
 Fire Protection / Industrial Machinery Manufacturing
 



**About SVS Buildwel** 




 SVS Buildwel has manufactured and installed fire safety and ELV systems for 18 years, serving government, PSU, metro, railway and hospital clients across India. Our Firetrex clean\-agent suppression systems are built in our own plant in Rohini, Delhi — not rebranded.
 



**The role** 




 We are creating a dedicated QC Engineer position at the plant.
 



 That matters more here than in most factories. A fire suppression system is only tested in a real emergency. A defect that escapes our gate is not discovered until the system is needed. You will be the last person between the shop floor and that moment.
 



 You will report to the DGM — Production, Planning \& QC.
 



**What you will do** 



* Incoming inspection of bought\-out material against specification, and collection of test certificates at receipt
* In\-process inspection at defined hold points on the line
* Final QC and functional testing on every unit before release
* Cylinder weighing, pressure testing and leak testing, with records maintained at serial level
* Own the calibration register for all gauges and instruments, and withdraw anything out of calibration
* Raise non\-conformance reports, drive disposition, and verify corrective action closes the root cause rather than the symptom
* Handle pre\-dispatch inspections by clients, consultants and third\-party inspectors — you will face them directly
* Maintain batch and serial traceability so any dispatched unit can be traced back to its material and its operator
* Feed quarterly warranty failure data back into production and design



**What you need** 



* Diploma or B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
* 3–6 years in quality control in a manufacturing plant — pressure vessels, cylinders, valves, fire equipment, HVAC or comparable engineered products
* Hands\-on with pressure testing, leak testing, weighing and the associated record keeping
* Working knowledge of calibration control, and of raising and closing non\-conformance reports
* Able to read engineering drawings and a bill of materials, and inspect against a written specification rather than by eye
* Able to hold a rejection under commercial pressure. This is part of the job, not an edge case



**Nice to have** 



* Exposure to PESO requirements for gas cylinders and filling
* Experience facing client, consultant or third\-party pre\-dispatch inspection
* ISO 9001 quality system experience, including internal audit
* Exposure to clean agent systems — FK\-5\-1\-12, NOVEC, FM\-200 or similar



**Why this role** 




 You will not be inheriting someone else's quality system. There isn't one yet. You will define the hold points, build the records, set up calibration control, and decide what "passed" means at this plant — with direct access to the department head and no layer in between.
 



 If you have spent three or four years executing a QC plan somebody else wrote, this is the step where you write it.
 



**To apply:** 
 send your CV to dip@svslifesafety.com with "QC Engineer — Plant" in the subject line.

**Job Description**
**Job Overview:**
 The JDE Finance Functional Consultant provides functional leadership and hands\-on support for JD Edwards EnterpriseOne financial processes. The role partners with Accounting, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Treasury, Tax, Project Controls and technical teams to sustain reliable transaction processing, period close, financial integrity and compliant change. The consultant combines strong accounting\-process knowledge with expert JDE configuration and troubleshooting capability.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**
* Provide Level 2 and Level 3 functional support for JDE EnterpriseOne financial modules and related integrations.
* Support General Accounting, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, cash or banking, allocations, multicurrency, tax and financial reporting processes based on assigned scope.
* Analyze posting, balancing, batch, voucher, invoice, receipt, payment and close issues; determine root cause and corrective action.
* Maintain and advise on financial configuration including companies, business units, object/subsidiary accounts, automatic accounting instructions, ledger types, document types, payment setup and period controls.
* Trace transactions from originating modules through account determination, batches and general ledger posting.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and develop functional designs, configuration workbooks, process flows, test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with Supply Chain, Projects, Payroll, Tax and integration teams to manage cross\-module accounting impacts.
* Coordinate with JDE development and CNC/technical teams on reports, interfaces, batch jobs, custom applications, orchestrations and performance issues.
* Plan and execute unit, integration, regression and user acceptance testing with complete evidence and reconciliation.
* Support month\-end and year\-end close, releases, patches, upgrades, cutovers and post\-production stabilization.
* Assess application\-control and segregation\-of\-duties impacts for finance changes; support audit evidence and remediation.
* Create and maintain functional specifications, configuration documents, knowledge articles, runbooks and user guidance.


**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications and Education:**
* Degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Finance functional experience.
* Deep experience in General Accounting plus at least two of the following: Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Job Costing, cash/banking, multicurrency, tax or financial reporting.
* Strong understanding of accounting entries, subledger\-to\-ledger integration, reconciliations and period\-end processing.
* Hands\-on knowledge of JDE financial setup, processing options, versions, user\-defined codes, automatic accounting instructions and batch posting.
* Ability to analyze JDE tables, reports, batches and integrations to resolve complex production issues.
* Experience with JDE EnterpriseOne 9\.2 and modern UX or orchestration capabilities.
* Experience with requirements, functional specifications, testing, change management and support documentation.
* Exposure to banking interfaces, tax engines, consolidation, EPM and payroll integrations.
* Experience in a global, multi\-company and multicurrency environment.


 \#DICE
   

  

**About Us**
 Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
   

  

 For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

title: Product Quality Intern
description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building more than just AI tools; we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post\-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world. From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
   

  

 We’re a fast\-growing, passionate team backed over 100K\+ active users globally.
   

  

 But we’re just getting started. Our mission is clear: solve the biggest pain points in photography, and keep evolving with photographers who use our tools daily.
   

  

 If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.
   

  

 🚀
 **About the Role**
 A wedding photographer shoots 4,000 photos on a Saturday.
   

  

 Before Aftershoot, that meant three nights hunched over a screen, clicking through near\-identical frames, missing dinner, missing their kids, missing the life they take pictures of for everyone else.
   

  

 With Aftershoot, it takes an hour.
   

  

 That hour is the entire product. 100,000\+ photographers around the world trust us with it. Culling, editing, retouching \- our AI does the grunt work so they can go back to doing the thing they actually love.
   

  

 Which means when we ship a bug, we don't ship an inconvenience. We ship somebody's ruined Sunday. That's where you come in.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Every engineer here builds a piece of the product. The PM holds the plan for it. Design holds the intent.
   

  

 You're the only person on the team whose entire job is to know what the product
 **actually does** 
 .
   

  

 Not what the ticket said. Not what the spec promised. What happens when a photographer drags in 12,000 RAW files, loses Wi\-Fi halfway through, closes the laptop lid, and reopens it four hours later on battery.
   

  

 We're not hiring you to tick boxes on a test sheet. You'll write code, own an automation suite, and hold the call on whether something is fit to go in front of 100,000 photographers. We're hiring you to become the person we can't ship without.
   

  

**Here's the bar we're setting, out loud:**
 Six months in, when an engineer and a PM disagree about how a flow is supposed to behave, someone in that room should say "just ask \[your name]" and that settles it.
   

  

 You will know this product better than the people who built it. That's not a stretch goal. That's the job.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Basic programming in JavaScript or TypeScript
* Comfort with browser developer tools

title: Sr. QA Analyst

**Job Purpose**
 A leading independent academic publishing company is seeking a Sr. QA Analyst to ensure the quality and reliability of its business systems. The ideal candidate will meticulously test and analyse our software applications to maintain the highest standards of performance and functionality.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 The job functions include, but are not limited to, the following:
   

  

* Own test strategy for features and cross\-system initiatives, defining scope, approach, coverage, dependencies, and test requirements.
* Apply risk\-based testing to identify critical scenarios, regression scope, and integration risks, and determine what should be tested, deferred, or excluded based on requirements and business impact.
* Understand end\-to\-end system flows and integrations, including upstream/downstream impacts, APIs, data flows, and system dependencies.
* Define and review high\-level test scenarios for complex features and integrated products, ensuring coverage of key functional, negative, boundary, and business\-risk scenarios.
* Work closely with Product Owners and Engineers from the requirements stage to understand business and technical requirements, identify gaps, risks, and testability concerns, and provide QA input early in the lifecycle.
* Test complex features, integrations, and bug fixes using appropriate manual and technical testing techniques, including API and database testing, and investigate defects to identify root causes.
* Drive test automation by identifying suitable automation opportunities and independently developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting automation scripts in collaboration with automation engineers.
* Assess test results and quality risks, provide input on release readiness, and proactively communicate issues that may impact quality, timelines, or business outcomes.
* Mentor and guide QA team members on requirements, test strategy, scenario design, integrations, and troubleshooting, and review their test coverage where needed.
* Represent the QA team in cross\-functional discussions, clearly communicating testing status, risks, dependencies, and priorities, while maintaining strong relationships with Product, Engineering, and other QA teams.
* Coordinate integration testing for integrated products, working across teams to manage dependencies, test data, environments, and testing timelines.
* Contribute to improving automation coverage, QA practices, and test processes, including CI/CD integration where applicable.
* Contribute to hiring, onboarding, knowledge sharing, and QA process improvements, and actively participate in Agile ceremonies and team activities.
* Demonstrate ownership, curiosity, and sound judgment by proactively exploring system behaviour and business flows, raising risks early, and making informed testing decisions with minimal supervision.


**Technical Skills**
 Skills, Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

* Manual \& Regression Testing: Strong experience testing complex features and integrated systems, with a focus on regression coverage and system dependencies.
* Automation: Hands\-on experience developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting automation scripts using Python, PyTest, and Playwright, with an eagerness to quickly learn new programming languages, tools, and technologies. Experience identifying automation opportunities and improving automation coverage.
* Test Strategy \& Risk\-Based Testing: Ability to develop test strategies, define test scope, identify critical scenarios, and make risk\-based decisions on test coverage.
* Integration \& System Knowledge: Strong understanding of end\-to\-end business flows, system integrations, APIs, data flows, and upstream/downstream dependencies.
* Requirements \& Testability Analysis: Ability to analyse business and technical requirements, identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and testability concerns, and provide QA input early in the development lifecycle.
* Technical Troubleshooting \& Root Cause Analysis: Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across applications, APIs, databases, and integrated systems, using logs, data, and system behaviour to identify root causes.
* Test Management \& Defect Tracking: Experienced in test case/scenario design, execution, defect investigation, tracking, and resolution.
* API \& Database Testing: Hands\-on experience with API testing (e.g., Postman/SoapUI) and SQL/database validation; basic understanding of performance testing.
* Agile: Experience working in Agile teams and actively participating in planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and other relevant ceremonies.
* QA Process Improvement: Contributes to QA standards, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* GenAI: Experience using GenAI tools to improve QA efficiency, test design, analysis, and productivity.


**Soft Skills**
* Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management: Works effectively with Product Owners, Engineers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, dependencies, and risks.
* Communication: Clearly communicates technical information, testing status, risks, and recommendations to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Confidently communicates QA perspectives, challenges assumptions constructively, and influences technical and business decisions based on quality, risk, and customer impact.
* Curiosity \& Continuous Learning: Proactively explores systems, integrations, business processes, and new technologies to deepen understanding and identify potential risks.
* Mentorship: Guides QA team members on requirements, test scenarios, integrations, testing approaches, and troubleshooting.
* Problem\-Solving \& Decision\-Making: Uses critical thinking, technical analysis, and risk assessment to identify issues and make sound testing decisions.
* Ownership \& Accountability: Dependable in delivering commitments, proactively raises risks and blockers, and follows through on responsibilities with minimal supervision.
* Adaptability: Responds effectively to changing requirements, priorities, and business needs.
* Team Representation: Represents the QA team effectively in cross\-functional discussions and ensures QA perspectives, risks, and priorities are clearly communicated.
* Professional Maturity: Demonstrates sound judgment, emotional intelligence, composure, and the ability to balance technical, business, and team priorities.


**Work Requirements**
* Availability: Willing and available to work UK business hours.

 At Sage we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that is representative of all sections of society and to sustaining a culture that celebrates difference, encourages authenticity, and creates a deep sense of belonging. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, color, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief as creating value through diversity is what makes us strong.
   

  

 Sage is a global academic publisher of books, journals, and library resources with a growing range of technologies to enable discovery, access, and engagement. title: Senior Staff Design Quality Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 CooperSurgical is a leading fertility and women’s healthcare company dedicated to putting time on the side of women, babies, and families at the healthcare moments that matter most in life. As a division of CooperCompanies, we're driven by a unified purpose to enable patients to experience life's beautiful moments. Guided by our shared values – dedicated, innovative, friendly, partners, and do the right thing – our offerings support patients throughout their lifetimes, from contraception to fertility and birth solutions, to women’s and family care, and beyond. We currently offer over 600 clinically relevant medical devices to healthcare providers, including testing and treatment options, as well as an innovative suite of assisted reproductive technology and genomic testing solutions. Learn more at www.coopersurgical.com.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Senior Staff Design Quality Engineer will provide technical leadership to ensure the successful development of Cooper products and ongoing operational support. This individual will be expected to apply his/her knowledge of design controls, risk management, verification and validation principles and quality engineering techniques to ensure safe and effective products are developed and manufactured in accordance with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements and customer requirements.
   

  

 The Senior Staff Design Quality Engineer provides expert guidance on scientific and technical data as it pertains to product and product testing and lead teams to identify and solve complex product problems. This position partners cross\-functionally with R\&D, Operations, Regulatory, Supplier Quality, and Clinical teams, and provides mentorship (including coaching, reviewing, training, delegating work) to peers, leads and less experienced DQEs, and cross\-functional engineering teams.
   

  

* Design Quality Leadership
+ Represent the Quality function on product/process development teams.
+ Mentor other discipline as needed in the Quality Engineering methodology.
+ Ensures that design control requirements are being met in an effective manner, including those for design verification, validation, specification and procedure development, risk management, design reviews, and design changes. May serve as independent reviewer during design reviews, or conduct DHF audits, as required.
+ Owner/Approver of one or more processes within the scope of Design Quality.

* Supplier Engagement
+ Manage supplier new tooling to ensure final components are qualified at the supplier and on time utilizing PPAP tool.
+ Participates in supplier selection process and specification reviews with suppliers to ensure that purchased items meet Cooper’s specifications.
+ Specifies quality characteristics and inspection plans for components, subassemblies, and finished devices with the Engineering Team.
+ Review/Approval of PPAP. May serve as PPAP lead.

* CAPAs/Non conformances/HHE
+ Lead or Participate in the investigation of complex product problems. Identify and manage corrective actions resulting from problem investigations.
+ Evaluates and dispositions nonconforming materials and products used in pilot and clinical builds.
+ Conducts or supports health risk assessments in support of the Health Hazard Evaluation, Reporting or Recall processes.

* Design
+ Participate in design reviews to evaluate designs and to help identify alternative design solutions.
+ Hands on participant in early stages of product development including but not limited to physician interaction, product engineering, competitive product testing, and prototype testing.
+ Provides input to design and manufacturing documentation including material specifications, drawings, inspection procedures, and manufacturing procedures, to ensure that the resulting products can be adequately manufactured and tested
+ Contributes to design input requirements from experience with previously reported problems, Cooper’s products, competitive devices and/or other similar products.
+ Approves deviations and design changes, conducts impact assessments, and defines/approves implementation plans.

* Verification \& Validation
+ Participate in the development of the master test plans (I.E. trace matrix, VMP….) that encompass design verification, design validation and process validation activities.
+ Creation, evaluation, and validation of product and process test methods.
+ Evaluates test protocols and reports to ensure that the testing is sufficient to meet regulatory requirements and quality objectives.

* Risk Management
+ Defines risk management strategy throughout product lifecycle including construction of the Risk Management File, Risk Management Planning, and benefit\-risk evaluations.
+ Identifies and manages risk throughout the development process with the use of FMEAs and/or other risk management tools, ensuring effective integration of risk activities throughout product realization process and feedback into design improvements and maintenance of the product risk profile. This includes leading the Risk management efforts of the design process and working with design team and management team on managing product and process risks.

* Process Improvement and Project Management
+ Leads strategic initiatives as aligned with organizational quality objectives. May manage a cross functional team to execute plans.
+ Actively identifies and leads opportunities for improvements across all cross functional departments.
+ Promotes continuous improvement in design control and risk management activities and use of quality tools with design team and other departments.

* Regulatory
+ Comply with applicable FDA and international regulatory laws/standards and the Cooper’s Code of Conduct.
+ Maintain knowledge of current regulatory requirements and standards as they pertain to the development and release of medical devices. Implement new or updated standards into existing procedures.
+ Represent Cooper as needed in FDA, notified body, internal, and other audits.

* Technical Mentorship
+ Serve as a technical mentor to QEs, providing guidance on complex quality engineering topics.
+ Promote continuous improvement and consistent application of design quality tools and methodologies.
+ Acts as a recognized subject matter expert in one or more DQE domains across the organization.

* Thorough knowledge of statistics and how to apply, evaluate, and provide recommendation from the data.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications**
* Advanced working knowledge of FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820\), ISO 13485, EU MDR.
* Demonstrated knowledge in the application of medical device design controls, verification/validation, risk management principles per ISO 14971, and the use of risk assessment tools such as FMEA, Hazard Analysis.
* Intermediate skill in the use of Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Advanced preferred.
* Ability to read and understand highly technical material.
* Proficient in reading and writing in English
* Self\-motivated and committed to a team approach
* Strong interpersonal, organizational and project management skills. Ability and experience interfacing with senior leadership and external stakeholders.
* Strong oral, presentation and technical writing skills
* Demonstrated skills in decision making, problem solving, negotiation, and influencing without direct authority preferably across a broad spectrum of Quality Engineering responsibilities
* Proven experience leading cross\-functional teams in a medical device development environment.
* Experience with Change Control, Non\-conformance, Deviation, Complaints, HHEs and/or CAPAs.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with acute attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Knowledge in Knowledge in application of IEC 62304 preferred.
* Knowledge in one or more ISO 10993, IEC 62366, ISO 11607, ISO 11137, or ISO 11135 preferred.


**Experience:**
* 10\+ years experience in Quality Engineering in the medical device industry with a Bachelors Degree, or 8\+ years with a Masters Degree, experience in related engineering areas, e.g. R\&D; or Manufacturing may also be applicable if experience includes work responsibilities listed above.
* Hands ‑ on experience in medical device product development in concept through commercialization, and/or leading design changes, improvements or remediation initiatives in sustaining operations. Knowledge in women’s health a plus.
* This role require 50% travelling \- Globally

 Backed by RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV, and Think Investments and bolstered by a $13 million growth round in June 2025 (total funding: $68 million), GoKwik is scaling aggressively across India, the UK, Europe, and the US.

 As GoKwik continues to expand its eCommerce enablement stack, the Implementation team plays a key role in onboarding, enabling, and empowering our merchant partners. This role is at the intersection of product, engineering, and merchant success — responsible for gathering requirements, implementing SaaS solutions, and supporting merchants with integration and product adoption. You’ll be the tech enabler who ensures merchants derive maximum value from GoKwik’s solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**

**Internal Collaboration \& Feedback Loops**

**Merchant Experience \& Enablement**

* Ensure merchants are set up for long\-term success with GoKwik’s suite of products
* Monitor implementation milestones, escalate roadblocks, and ensure timely delivery


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field

* Hands\-on experience with Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento integrations

title: Founding member, Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Are you looking to join an organization that is growing and dynamic? What about a high\-energy, collaborative environment that rewards hard work?**




 J.S. Held is a global consulting firm that combines technical, scientific, financial, and strategic expertise to advise clients seeking to realize value and mitigate risk. Our professionals serve as trusted advisors to organizations facing high stakes matters demanding urgent attention, staunch integrity, proven experience, clear\-cut analysis, and an understanding of both tangible and intangible assets.
   

  





 The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, products, and data that enable clients to navigate complex, contentious, and often catastrophic situations.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 The Quality Assurance Engineer is responsible for ensuring the reliability, accuracy, and performance of J.S. Held’s enterprise applications by designing and executing comprehensive testing strategies. This role plays a key part in reducing operational risk, improving user experience, and ensuring the consistent delivery of high\-quality solutions across integrated systems.
   

  





 As an early member of J.S. Held’s growing hub in Delhi, India, this individual will join a newly expanding team and have the unique opportunity to help shape quality assurance practices, contribute to operational excellence, and support the development of a high\-performing regional presence. Working alongside other new hires, this role will play an important part in establishing processes, fostering collaboration, and building a strong foundation for the hub’s continued growth and success.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Test Strategy \& Planning**



* Develop and execute QA strategies for enterprise applications and integrations
* Define test plans, test cases, and acceptance criteria aligned to business requirements
* Partner with Product Managers and Business Analysts to ensure adequate test coverage
* Take ownership in establishing and enhancing QA methodologies, processes, and governance practices, demonstrating a proactive and self\-directed approach to quality assurance initiatives
* Bring a Builder Mindset and take ownership in establishing and enhancing QA methodologies, processes, and governance practices, demonstrating a proactive and self\-directed approach to quality assurance initiatives



**Test Execution \& Automation**



* Perform functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing support
* Build and maintain automated test scripts where applicable
* Validate accuracy of workflows across time, expense, billing, and project systems
* Demonstrate a hands\-on, results\-oriented mindset with the ability to independently identify quality risks, drive testing activities, and deliver solutions with minimal supervision



**Performance Testing Competency**



* Design and execute non\-functional testing including performance, load, and reliability validation
* Validate system behavior under failure conditions (timeouts, API errors, downstream failures)
* Manage test environments and coordinate test data setup across systems
   

  

 • Ensure test data accuracy, completeness, and alignment with production scenarios
* Perform API testing including request/response validation, schema verification, and error handling scenarios
* Validate authentication, authorization, and data exchange patterns across integrations
* Execute release validation, including smoke testing and post\-deployment verification
* Validate rollback procedures and ensure production readiness prior to release
* Collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams and stakeholders across multiple time zones to support testing, release, and project commitments
* Maintain schedule flexibility, when required, to accommodate meetings, testing activities, and critical project milestones involving team members across different regions and UTC time zones



**Defect Management \& Resolution**



* Identify, document, and track defects through resolution
* Collaborate with engineering and product teams to prioritize fixes
* Ensure releases meet defined quality and performance standards



**Integration \& Data Validation**



* Validate end\-to\-end workflows across multiple interconnected systems
* Ensure data integrity across ERP, workflow tools, and reporting platforms
* Support testing of APIs, data pipelines, and system integrations



**Continuous Improvement**



* Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to reduce defects
* Contribute to QA best practices, standards, and documentation
* Support enhancements to release management and testing processes
* Act as Player/Coach, mentor, and support team members in developing QA and testing skills, promoting best practices and fostering a quality\-first mindset across the team
* Contribute to building and maturing the organization's QA processes, standards, and testing frameworks through a proactive and continuous improvement approach


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* 8\+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing
* Experience with enterprise applications, ERP systems, or multi\-system integrations
* Familiarity with test automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, or similar)
* Experience with test case management and defect tracking tools (e.g., Azure DevOps)
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail



**Preferred Attributes**



* Experience in professional services or consulting environments
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies
* Ability to work across distributed teams and complex system landscapes


**Additional Information**

**Some of the Benefits We Have Include**




 J.S. Held understands all our employees are people and sometimes life needs flexibility. We work to always provide an environment that best supports and suits our team’s needs.
   

  




* Our flexible work environment allows employees to work remotely, when needed
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Commuter Benefit



**Other Duties**




 Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
   

  





 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read the J.S. Held Online Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as required and described therein. California residents can click here to learn more about the personal information we collect and here to learn about additional privacy rights that may be available.
   

  





 Please explore what we’re all about at www.jsheld.com.
   

  





**EEO and Job Accommodations**




*We embrace diversity and our commitment to building a team and environment that fosters professional and personal enrichment is unwavering. We are greater when we are equal!*




*J.S. Held is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to hiring a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.*




*If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request for a reasonable accommodation, please email* 
*jobs@jsheld.com* 
*and include “Applicant Accommodation” within the subject line with your request and contact information.*

 The Quality Assurance Manager owns the accuracy and US GAAP compliance of all client accounting

 US GAAP compliance before delivery.

 clients.

 quality matters, and keep internal standards current with evolving US GAAP.

 cycle accounting and bookkeeping for US clients, with the ability to make and defend correct
 



 treatment decisions.

 frameworks and checklists, scrutinize deliverables for accuracy and completeness, and
 



 systematically reduce errors and rework.

 US clients, ideally gained in an outsourcing, shared\-services, or offshore delivery setting.

 produced in (QuickBooks Online/Desktop, Xero, Bill.com, and similar), enabling efficient and
 



 credible review.

 applying automation or AI\-assisted tools to improve quality and throughput in a delivery
 



 environment.

 content, coaching individuals, and lifting overall team competency and consistency.

 • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Commerce, or Finance.

title: Quality Analyst
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
   

  

 At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
   

  

 A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
   

  

 As a Quality Analyst, you will support the Quality Manager and the broader team in maintaining quality controls, executing calibration reviews, and ensuring smooth auditing operations with our vendor partners. You will play a crucial role in validating audit accuracy, analysing performance trends, and identifying grading discrepancies, helping to safeguard platform integrity and streamline vendor quality processes.
   

  

**You Will**
* Assist in executing regular quality compliance reviews and operational audits to ensure vendors adhere to established grading rubrics.
* Conduct daily audits of vendor customer service and moderation audits to verify accuracy and policy alignment.
* Gather, format, and maintain quality performance metrics and audit data to highlight recurring errors or vendor grading drift.
* Support the Lead in coordinating with Moderation, Customer Support, and Global Scaled Operations teams to resolve quality disputes.
* Participate in calibration sessions to ensure consistent interpretation of trust and safety policies across all vendor sites.
* Help test and implement new quality automation tools or auditing platforms introduced by the technical and leadership teams.


**You Have**
* 3\-5 years of experience in quality assurance, moderation, compliance, or a trust and safety\-related role.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent foundational experience in operational auditing.
* Proficiency in spreadsheet software like Excel or Google Sheets for tracking audit results and basic trend analysis.
* Highly organised with a strong ability to identify subtle discrepancies in moderation decisions and data entries.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills used to document audit findings and provide feedback to vendor teams.
* Ability to troubleshoot routine quality issues and apply policy rubrics to complex user cases independently.
